name: Superhero
definition: A superhero character recorded as one row of the superhero table. It is the central entity that publisher, race, gender, alignment, eye/hair/skin colour, body metrics, scored attributes and superpowers all describe.
scope: Any analysis that counts, filters, ranks or describes superheroes in the superhero database.

name: Superhero Name
definition: The published codename or display name of a superhero, stored in superhero.superhero_name. This is the name a question asks for when it says 'which hero' or 'heroes' names'.
scope: Identifying and listing heroes; selecting a hero by name.

name: Hero Full Name
definition: The civilian or full personal name of a superhero, stored in superhero.full_name, as opposed to the published codename in superhero_name.
scope: Questions that ask for a hero's 'full name' or real identity.

name: Publisher
definition: The publishing company that owns or distributes a superhero, stored in the publisher table and referenced by superhero.publisher_id.
scope: Filtering, grouping, ranking and counting heroes by publisher.

name: Superpower
definition: A named ability possessed by a hero, stored in superpower.power_name and linked to heroes through the hero_power table. It is a free-text vocabulary of power names, not a scored trait.
scope: Filtering heroes by ability and listing the abilities of a given hero.

name: Colour
definition: The shared colour value vocabulary held in the colour table. One colour id/name is reused as the value domain for a hero's eye, hair and skin colour, so the same colour id means the same colour in all three positions.
scope: Interpreting and comparing colour values of heroes.

name: Eye Colour
definition: The colour of a hero's eyes, held as superhero.eye_colour_id and resolved through the shared colour vocabulary.
scope: Filtering or reporting heroes by eye colour.

name: Hair Colour
definition: The colour of a hero's hair, held as superhero.hair_colour_id and resolved through the shared colour vocabulary.
scope: Filtering or reporting heroes by hair colour.

name: Skin Colour
definition: The colour of a hero's skin, held as superhero.skin_colour_id and resolved through the shared colour vocabulary.
scope: Reporting hero skin colour and comparing it with eye or hair colour.

name: Hero Attribute
definition: One of six named traits a hero may be rated on: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat. The trait name is held in attribute.attribute_name and the hero's rating in hero_attribute.attribute_value.
scope: Superlative and comparison questions about a hero's capabilities, such as strongest, dumbest or fastest.

name: Attribute Value
definition: The integer rating a hero receives on one hero attribute, stored in hero_attribute.attribute_value. Superlatives are taken over this value for a specified attribute name.
scope: Ranking, thresholding or comparing heroes on a scored trait.

name: Intelligence Attribute
definition: The hero attribute named 'Intelligence' in attribute.attribute_name, measuring mental capability. Low values correspond to the colloquial idea of a 'dumb' hero.
scope: Reasoning about how smart or dumb a hero is.

name: Strength Attribute
definition: The hero attribute named 'Strength' in attribute.attribute_name, measuring physical strength.
scope: Reasoning about how strong a hero is.

name: Speed Attribute
definition: The hero attribute named 'Speed' in attribute.attribute_name, measuring movement speed as a scored stat. It is distinct from the superpower named 'Super Speed'.
scope: Reasoning about how fast a hero is on the scored attribute scale.

name: Durability Attribute
definition: The hero attribute named 'Durability' in attribute.attribute_name, measuring how much damage a hero can withstand.
scope: Reasoning about how tough a hero is.

name: Power Attribute
definition: The hero attribute named 'Power' in attribute.attribute_name, measuring raw energy or power output as a scored stat. It is not the same as the superpower vocabulary.
scope: Reasoning about a hero's raw power rating.

name: Combat Attribute
definition: The hero attribute named 'Combat' in attribute.attribute_name, measuring hand-to-hand fighting skill.
scope: Reasoning about a hero's fighting skill rating.

name: Race
definition: The species or origin classification of a hero, stored in the race table and referenced by superhero.race_id. Includes mundane origins such as 'Human' as well as alien and cosmic species.
scope: Filtering heroes by species or origin.

name: Gender
definition: The gender classification of a hero, stored in the gender table and referenced by superhero.gender_id.
scope: Filtering or grouping heroes by gender.

name: Alignment
definition: The moral alignment classification of a hero, stored in the alignment table and referenced by superhero.alignment_id.
scope: Filtering or grouping heroes as good, bad or neutral.

name: Height
definition: A hero's height expressed in centimetres and stored in superhero.height_cm. The recorded range spans ordinary human heights and extreme values for giant or cosmic characters.
scope: Height ranges, height comparisons and body-size analysis.

name: Weight
definition: A hero's weight expressed in kilograms and stored in superhero.weight_kg. The recorded range spans ordinary human weights and extreme values for giant or cosmic characters.
scope: Weight ranges, weight comparisons and analysis of heroes whose weight is not recorded.

name: Missing Value Convention
definition: The conventions by which this database records that a value is unknown: SQL NULL, a numeric 0 in height_cm and weight_kg, the text placeholder '-' in full_name and race, and the colour value 'No Colour' for an unrecorded colour. Different columns use different encodings for the same 'unknown' meaning.
scope: Any filter, count or aggregate that must include, exclude or explicitly target heroes whose attribute is not recorded.

name: Hero Count
definition: The number of superhero records that satisfy a condition, counted over superhero.id. It is the base measure behind questions such as 'how many heroes' and 'which publisher created more'.
scope: Counting heroes, in total or within any filtered or grouped population.

name: Colour Popularity
definition: How frequently a colour value occurs among a population of heroes, used to rank colour values from most to least common within that population.
scope: Ranking or comparing colour values by how many heroes share them.

name: Percentage Share
definition: The proportion of a hero population that belongs to a subgroup, expressed as a percentage of the population total.
scope: Stating what fraction of a set of heroes meets a condition.

name: Count Difference
definition: The arithmetic difference between two hero counts computed on a comparable population, used to state how many more or fewer heroes one group has than another.
scope: Comparing the size of two hero subgroups.
